mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 86 degrees, feeling like 94, around the area of Badger Ridge Middle School.

Work on the highway M construction project enters phase two the week of September 7, which will shift traffic into the eastbound lanes for about three weeks. Additionally, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics wooden sculpture, created by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, is now on display at Century School Park.

There is plenty to do with live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from the week, officers responded to a collision on August 28 where a driver struck a parked vehicle on South Nine Mound Road and was subsequently cited for inattentive driving.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM this evening.
